$comment: Every commit on a pull request carries its provedone receipt (a `Verified-by:` line) before it can merge. burgee is not listed: its `Quality Gate`, already required, needs the `provedone receipts` job (quality.yml), so a second required context would only add a name to keep in step with scripts/required-checks.mts. Repository admins bypass (RELEASE_BOT_PAT acts as one). GitHub Actions cannot be a bypass actor on a personal account's repos (the API answers 422); no workflow here pushes to main with GITHUB_TOKEN, they all open PRs. Applied by .github/workflows/rulesets.yml.
